onboarding.step3.body: Edit your profile, add friends, chat, and share played instances or playlists.

onboarding.step4.body: Search music, import playlists, discover servers, and keep the player ready.

crash.hint.incompatible_mods: Some mods don't work with each other or with this Minecraft/loader version. Update or disable the listed mods, or change the loader version in the instance settings.
crash.hint.missing_dependency: A mod needs another mod that isn't installed (for example Fabric API). Install it from the mods tab or remove the mod that requires it.
crash.hint.duplicate_mod: There are two copies of the same mod in the mods folder. Delete the older one and launch again.
crash.hint.wrong_loader: There are Fabric mods in a Forge/NeoForge instance (or the other way around). Remove them or create an instance with the right loader.
crash.hint.mixin: The listed mod doesn't support this game version or conflicts with another mod. Update or disable it.
crash.hint.mod_crash: The crash report points at these mods. Update or disable them and try again.
crash.hint.java_version: The game or a mod needs Java {0}. In the instance settings, use automatic Java or pick Java {0}.
crash.hint.graphics_driver: Minecraft couldn't use your graphics card (OpenGL). Update your {0} driver from the manufacturer's website. On laptops, make javaw.exe use the dedicated GPU.
crash.hint.out_of_memory: Increase the allocated RAM in Settings (6–8 GB for big modpacks) or remove heavy mods.
crash.hint.heap_reservation: You allocated more RAM than your PC can give. Lower it in Settings and leave at least 3–4 GB free for Windows.
crash.hint.corrupt_files: Some files were downloaded incorrectly or blocked by your antivirus. In the folder shown, delete the libraries and versions folders (they are downloaded again) and launch again.
crash.hint.access_denied: Windows or your antivirus blocked access to this folder. Add the Modstack folder to your antivirus exclusions and close other programs using it.
crash.hint.disk_full: There's no space left on the disk. Free some space and try again.
crash.hint.network: The game files couldn't be downloaded. Check your internet, turn off VPN or proxy, or enable secure DNS in Settings.
crash.hint.unknown: We couldn't identify the exact cause. The error lines are below: copy the details if you ask for help.
